#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare concrete right34 arithmetic data and original triangle adapter.

This converter does not discover witnesses or change packed tags, signatures,
floor values, vertices, or masks. All are parsed from exact frozen source bytes.
It never installs files or invokes Lean. It must not be run before the exact
bridge source has passed independent review; the required receipt records that
source-review gate, not kernel acceptance.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PINS = {
    "pair_backend_next/staged_pilots_floor_fix/D1Bound5/SmallPairGraphInputs34.lean":
        "80081fbe80d8267dc85a4c97cf17a7c063a9e61364395f31e58acc93a3d048b9",
    "pair_literal_next/generated/SmallPairLiteralCachedData34.lean":
        "2b14c33742c58890230b20e7b3ee455905f4ac50c88dc86a4da3bd7719777af1",
    "pair_selected_next/generated/SmallPairSelectedData34.lean":
        "9a05216afd22493a58f74a21dd802492e7d8d57e0e80180cb8c7e7bd0d6e06c6",
    "finite_fast_next/sieves/SmallPairSieve_1_2.lean":
        "0e06eb108afce10f63dd87b8402973d477820e1a7d76cfa29f8e0be3d77d5235",
    "pair_light_next/left34_v2/SmallPairLightAssembly34.lean":
        "6a0195e9356ce602881ba23270aeac451918eed77e30e3bdb8e3b35be0fb5140",
    "pair_backend_next/staged_pilots_floor_fix/D1Bound5/SmallPairGraphTriangle34.lean":
        "ee1d0b12d916ba222e08b4b498244c450e380b6bcb43def23bf02d7d728c5a22",
    "pair_backend_next/staged_pilots_floor_fix/D1Bound5/SmallPairGraphArithmetic34.lean":
        "4fd515feae97b8be9538890f102e6379da84a749b5ea6b0ffea89e5e7e28cbc9",
    "pair_backend_next/staged_pilots_floor_fix/D1Bound5/SmallPairGraphClosure34.lean":
        "a5f83b9e9c8233fc7e1eafda5a5ecb640388506da389699f4913e630e946b9f2",
    "pair_backend_next/staged_pilots_floor_fix/D1Bound5/SmallPairGraphData34.lean":
        "d8ad1aa220dcaed2a832293313c73ab7450749353b1a506e9fa01fa978593a38",
    "pair_light_next/PairLightArithmetic.lean":
        "ac3b9e9f7d91be83861de5b2f384eb0c669c61cfa9bd323309d57565e89af6eb",
}


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def one_group(pattern: str, text: str) -> str:
    matches = re.findall(pattern, text, re.S)
    require(len(matches) == 1, "Expected one exact declaration block")
    return matches[0]


def complete_parse(pattern: str, body: str) -> list:
    result = re.findall(pattern, body)
    require(re.sub(pattern, "", body).replace(",", "").strip() == "",
            "Unparsed declaration data")
    return result


def lean_list(items: list[str]) -> str:
    return "[\n" + ",\n".join("  " + item for item in items) + "\n]"


def coord(z: tuple[int, int]) -> str:
    return f"({z[0]}, {z[1]})"


def natural_pairs(items: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> str:
    return "[" + ", ".join(f"({a}, {b})" for a, b in items) + "]"


def prepare(bridge_source: Path, bridge_review: Path, output: Path) -> dict:
    output = output.resolve()
    require(not output.exists(), "Output must be a new directory")
    require(output != ROOT and output not in ROOT.parents,
            "Output must not contain the workspace")
    for source in PINS:
        require(output != (ROOT / source).parent,
                "Output must not be an existing source directory")

    bridge_bytes = bridge_source.read_bytes()
    review_bytes = bridge_review.read_bytes()
    review = json.loads(review_bytes)
    require(review.get("source_sha256") == sha(bridge_bytes),
            "Review must pin the exact current bridge source")
    require(review.get("source_review_pass") is True,
            "Independent bridge source review must pass before generation")
    require(isinstance(review.get("reviewer"), str) and review["reviewer"],
            "Review receipt must identify its independent reviewer")

    data = {}
    for name, expected in PINS.items():
        blob = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        require(sha(blob) == expected, f"Frozen input changed: {name}")
        data[name] = blob
    inputs = data[next(p for p in PINS if p.endswith("SmallPairGraphInputs34.lean"))].decode()
    literal = data[next(p for p in PINS if p.endswith("SmallPairLiteralCachedData34.lean"))].decode()
    selected = data[next(p for p in PINS if p.endswith("SmallPairSelectedData34.lean"))].decode()
    sieve_source = data[next(p for p in PINS if p.endswith("SmallPairSieve_1_2.lean"))].decode()

    large_body = one_group(r"def smallPairLarge_34 .*? := \[(.*?)\n\]", inputs)
    all_vertices = [tuple(map(int, z)) for z in
                    complete_parse(r"⟨\s*(-?\d+)\s*,\s*(-?\d+)\s*⟩", large_body)]
    require(len(all_vertices) == 457 and len(set(all_vertices)) == 457,
            "Unexpected original large list")
    colors = int(one_group(r"def colors : ℕ := (\d+)", inputs))
    require(colors >> len(all_vertices) == 0, "Excess original color bits")
    indices = [i for i in range(len(all_vertices)) if ((colors >> i) & 1) == 1]
    vertices = [all_vertices[i] for i in indices]
    require(len(vertices) == 228, "This converter is only the original right34 class")

    record_body = one_group(r"def rightCached .*? := \[(.*?)\n\]", literal)
    pattern = r"⟨⟨(-?\d+),\s*(-?\d+)⟩,\s*(\[[^\]]*\])⟩"
    records = [((int(a), int(b)), ast.literal_eval(sig))
               for a, b, sig in complete_parse(pattern, record_body)]
    require([x for x, sig in records] == vertices,
            "Literal cached records must cover exactly the original split, in order")

    mask_defs = dict(re.findall(r"def (smallPairMask_1_2_\d+) : ℕ := (\d+)", sieve_source))
    sieve_body = one_group(r"def smallPairSieve_1_2 .*? := \[(.*?)\n\]", sieve_source)
    sieve = [(int(k), int(mask_defs[name])) for k, name in
             complete_parse(r"\((\d+),\s*(smallPairMask_1_2_\d+)\)", sieve_body)]
    require(len(sieve) == 25, "Unexpected original sieve length")
    require(all(sig == [(a % (k + 1), b % (k + 1)) for k, _ in sieve]
                for (a, b), sig in records), "Actual cached signatures mismatch")

    rows = ast.literal_eval(one_group(r"def rightRows .*? := (\[.*?\n\])", selected))
    require(len(rows) == 228, "Unexpected selected row count")
    require(all(isinstance(word, int) and word >= 0 and isinstance(ks, list)
                and all(isinstance(k, int) and k >= 0 for k in ks)
                for word, ks in rows), "Malformed original packed rows")
    require(sum(len(ks) for word, ks in rows) == 1 and rows[-1] == (0, []),
            "Original right34 sparse floor data changed")
    require(all(word >> (5 * (len(rows) - i - 1)) == 0
                for i, (word, ks) in enumerate(rows)), "Original packed word has excess tags")

    source = """import D1Bound5.PairLightArithmetic

namespace D1Bound5.PairLightRightPilot34
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

"""
    source += "def sieve : List (Nat × Nat) := " + lean_list([f"({k}, {mask})" for k, mask in sieve]) + "\n\n"
    source += "def rightVertices : List PairLightCoordinate := " + lean_list([coord(z) for z in vertices]) + "\n\n"
    source += "def rightCached : List PairLightCachedVertex := " + lean_list(
        [f"({coord(z)}, {natural_pairs(sig)})" for z, sig in records]) + "\n\n"
    source += "def rightRows : List (Nat × List Nat) := " + lean_list(
        [f"({word}, [{', '.join(map(str, ks))}])" for word, ks in rows]) + "\n\n"
    source += "end D1Bound5.PairLightRightPilot34\n"
    proof = """import D1Bound5.SmallPairLightRightData34

namespace D1Bound5.PairLightRightPilot34
set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

/-- Only the isolated arithmetic computation. Connection to the original
class requires the separately checked data equalities and exact bridge. -/
theorem right_certificate_checked :
    pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool 1 2 sieve
      rightVertices rightCached rightRows = true := by
  decide +kernel

end D1Bound5.PairLightRightPilot34
"""
    # This assembly is a side-specific copy of the reviewed left assembly.
    # No existing source is edited and every data connection stays explicit.
    assembly = data["pair_light_next/left34_v2/SmallPairLightAssembly34.lean"].decode()
    assembly = assembly.replace("SmallPairLightLeft34", "SmallPairLightRight34")
    assembly = assembly.replace("PairLightPilot34", "PairLightRightPilot34")
    assembly = assembly.replace("left", "right")
    old_split = "(pairSplitByMask smallPairLarge_34 PairGraphPrepared34.colors).1"
    require(assembly.count(old_split) == 3, "Unexpected left assembly shape")
    assembly = assembly.replace(old_split, old_split[:-1] + "2")

    triangle = data["pair_backend_next/staged_pilots_floor_fix/D1Bound5/SmallPairGraphTriangle34.lean"].decode()
    triangle_before = triangle
    for before, after in [
        ("import D1Bound5.SmallPairGraphLeft34", "import D1Bound5.SmallPairLightAssembly34"),
        ("import D1Bound5.SmallPairGraphRight34", "import D1Bound5.SmallPairLightRightAssembly34"),
        ("PairGraphPrepared34.left_checked", "PairLightPilot34.left_checked"),
        ("PairGraphPrepared34.right_checked", "PairLightRightPilot34.right_checked"),
    ]:
        require(triangle.count(before) == 1, "Unexpected original triangle source shape")
        triangle = triangle.replace(before, after)
    statement = r"theorem smallPairNoTriangle_34_checked\b(.*?) :="
    require(re.findall(statement, triangle_before, re.S) == re.findall(statement, triangle, re.S),
            "Original public triangle theorem type changed")

    files = {"SmallPairLightRightData34.lean": source.encode(),
             "SmallPairLightRight34.lean": proof.encode(),
             "SmallPairLightRightAssembly34.lean": assembly.encode(),
             "SmallPairGraphTriangle34.lean": triangle.encode()}
    report = {
        "status": "Uncompiled pure right34 pilot and original triangle adapter; no source installed",
        "generator_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),
        "source_pins": PINS,
        "bridge_source_sha256": sha(bridge_bytes),
        "bridge_source_review_sha256": sha(review_bytes),
        "bridge_source_review_is_not_kernel_acceptance": True,
        "model": {"tau": 1, "nu": 2}, "vertices": 228, "pairs": 25878,
        "signature_entries_per_vertex": 25, "floor_witnesses": 1,
        "original_split_indices": indices,
        "representation_changes_only": True,
        "mandatory_assembly_equalities": ["sieve", "rightVertices", "rightCached", "rightRows"],
        "public_triangle_theorem_type_unchanged": True,
        "original_arithmetic_closure_graphdata_unchanged": True,
        "left_dependency": "Previously prepared SmallPairLightAssembly34, source pin included",
        "full_graph_entry": "Existing SmallPairGraphData34 imports unchanged Arithmetic34/Closure34 plus this exact original-name Triangle34 adapter",
        "compile_order": ["SmallPairLightRightData34", "SmallPairLightRight34", "SmallPairLightRightAssembly34", "SmallPairGraphTriangle34", "SmallPairGraphData34"],
        "files": {name: {"sha256": sha(blob), "bytes": len(blob)} for name, blob in files.items()},
    }
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, blob in files.items():
        (output / name).write_bytes(blob)
    (output / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    require(all((ROOT / name).read_bytes() == blob for name, blob in data.items()),
            "A frozen source changed during preparation")
    return report


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--bridge-source", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--bridge-review", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = prepare(args.bridge_source, args.bridge_review, args.output)
    print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ["status", "vertices", "pairs", "files"]}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import D1Bound5.PairLightArithmetic
import D1Bound5.PairRawSelectedFloorWitnesses

namespace D1Bound5

/-- Forget only the quadratic-algebra structure, retaining both coordinates. -/
def pairLightCoordinates {tau nu : ℤ} (z : QuadInt tau nu) : PairLightCoordinate :=
  (z.re, z.im)

/-- Retain the exact vertex coordinates and the entire supplied signature. -/
def pairLightCachedCoordinates {tau nu : ℤ} (x : PairResidueVertex tau nu) :
    PairLightCachedVertex :=
  (pairLightCoordinates x.vertex, x.signature)

theorem pairLightCoordinates_injective {tau nu : ℤ} :
    Function.Injective (pairLightCoordinates (tau := tau) (nu := nu)) := by
  intro x y h
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  · exact congrArg Prod.snd h

theorem pairLightCoordinates_eq_iff {tau nu : ℤ} (x y : QuadInt tau nu) :
    pairLightCoordinates x = pairLightCoordinates y ↔ x = y :=
  ⟨fun h => pairLightCoordinates_injective h, congrArg pairLightCoordinates⟩

theorem pairLightCoordinates_list_eq_iff {tau nu : ℤ}
    (xs ys : List (QuadInt tau nu)) :
    xs.map pairLightCoordinates = ys.map pairLightCoordinates ↔ xs = ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => cases ys <;> simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases ys with
      | nil => simp
      | cons y ys => simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq,
          pairLightCoordinates_eq_iff, ih]

/-- This is the pinned integer-cast residue identity, including negative z
and modulus one. The modulus k+1 supplies the required nonzero instance. -/
theorem pairLight_intCast_val (k : ℕ) (z : ℤ) :
    (z : ZMod (k + 1)).val = (z % Int.ofNat (k + 1)).toNat := by
  simpa only [Int.toNat_natCast, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast] using
    congrArg Int.toNat (ZMod.val_intCast (n := k + 1) z)

theorem pairLightCoordinateResidues_eq {tau nu : ℤ} (k : ℕ) (z : QuadInt tau nu) :
    pairLightCoordinateResidues k (pairLightCoordinates z) = pairCoordinateResidues k z := by
  simp only [pairLightCoordinateResidues, pairLightCoordinates, pairCoordinateResidues,
    pairLight_intCast_val]

theorem pairLightCoordinateSignature_eq {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (z : QuadInt tau nu) :
    pairLightCoordinateSignature sieve (pairLightCoordinates z) =
      pairCoordinateSignature sieve z := by
  simp only [pairLightCoordinateSignature, pairCoordinateSignature,
    pairLightCoordinateResidues_eq]

theorem pairLightProductPlusOne_eq {tau nu : ℤ} (x y : QuadInt tau nu) :
    pairLightProductPlusOne tau nu (pairLightCoordinates x) (pairLightCoordinates y) =
      pairLightCoordinates (x * y + 1) := by
  apply Prod.ext <;>
    simp only [pairLightProductPlusOne, pairLightCoordinates,
      QuadraticAlgebra.re_add, QuadraticAlgebra.im_add,
      QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,
      QuadraticAlgebra.re_one, QuadraticAlgebra.im_one] <;> ring

theorem pairLightNorm_eq {tau nu : ℤ} (z : QuadInt tau nu) :
    pairLightNorm tau nu (pairLightCoordinates z) = z.norm := by
  simpa only [pairLightNorm, pairLightCoordinates] using (QuadInt.norm_formula z).symm

/-- Equality is unconditional, so unsupported traces and all malformed
natural signatures retain exactly the accepted mask behavior. -/
theorem pairLightResidueMaskNatBool_eq_raw (tau nu : ℤ) (k mask : ℕ) (u v : ℕ × ℕ) :
    pairLightResidueMaskNatBool tau nu k mask u v = pairResidueMaskNatBool tau nu k mask u v := by
  have hn : (-(nu : ZMod (k + 1))).val = ((-nu) % Int.ofNat (k + 1)).toNat := by
    simpa only [Int.cast_neg] using pairLight_intCast_val k (-nu)
  simp only [pairLightResidueMaskNatBool, pairResidueMaskNatBool, hn, pairLight_intCast_val]

theorem pairLightSelectedMaskRejectBool_eq_raw (tau nu : ℤ) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (xs ys : PairLightSignature) (i : ℕ) :
    pairLightSelectedMaskRejectBool tau nu sieve xs ys i =
      pairSelectedCachedMaskNatRejectBool tau nu sieve xs ys i := by
  cases hm : sieve[i]? with
  | none => simp only [pairLightSelectedMaskRejectBool, pairSelectedCachedMaskNatRejectBool, hm]
  | some item =>
      rcases item with ⟨k, mask⟩
      cases hx : xs[i]? <;> cases hy : ys[i]? <;>
        simp only [pairLightSelectedMaskRejectBool, pairSelectedCachedMaskNatRejectBool,
          hm, hx, hy, pairLightResidueMaskNatBool_eq_raw]

theorem pairLightNegativeIntegerObstructionBool_eq {tau nu : ℤ} (z : QuadInt tau nu) :
    pairLightNegativeIntegerObstructionBool tau nu (pairLightCoordinates z) =
      pairNegativeIntegerObstructionBool z := by
  rfl

theorem pairLightFloorObstructionBool_eq {tau nu : ℤ} (z : QuadInt tau nu) (k : ℕ) :
    pairLightFloorObstructionBool tau nu (pairLightCoordinates z) k =
      QuadInt.floorObstructionBool z k := by
  simp only [pairLightFloorObstructionBool, QuadInt.floorObstructionBool,
    pairLightNorm, pairLightCoordinates, QuadInt.norm_formula, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [decide_eq_decide] <;> rfl

/-- Every tail position, invalid tag, duplicate, guard branch and floor-list
case has exactly the old result. There is no data-validity premise. -/
theorem pairLightSelectedFloorRowBool_eq_raw {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (x : PairResidueVertex tau nu)
    (ys : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (code : ℕ) (ks : List ℕ) :
    pairLightSelectedFloorRowBool tau nu sieve (pairLightCachedCoordinates x)
      (ys.map pairLightCachedCoordinates) code ks =
      pairRawSelectedFloorRowBool sieve x ys code ks := by
  induction ys generalizing code ks with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
      simp only [pairLightCachedCoordinates] at ih
      cases ks <;>
        simp only [List.map_cons, pairLightSelectedFloorRowBool,
          pairRawSelectedFloorRowBool, pairLightCachedCoordinates,
          pairLightSelectedMaskRejectBool_eq_raw, pairLightCoordinates_eq_iff,
          pairLightProductPlusOne_eq, pairLightNegativeIntegerObstructionBool_eq,
          pairLightFloorObstructionBool_eq, ih]

theorem pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentBool_eq_raw {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu))
    (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ)) :
    pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentBool tau nu sieve
      (cached.map pairLightCachedCoordinates) rows =
      pairRawSelectedFloorIndependentBool sieve cached rows := by
  induction cached generalizing rows with
  | nil => cases rows <;> rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases rows with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons item rows =>
          rcases item with ⟨code, ks⟩
          simp only [List.map_cons, pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentBool,
            pairRawSelectedFloorIndependentBool, pairLightSelectedFloorRowBool_eq_raw, ih]

theorem pairLightCachedCoordinates_coverage_iff {tau nu : ℤ}
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu)) :
    (cached.map pairLightCachedCoordinates).map Prod.fst = vertices.map pairLightCoordinates ↔
      cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex = vertices := by
  have hmap : (cached.map pairLightCachedCoordinates).map Prod.fst =
      (cached.map PairResidueVertex.vertex).map pairLightCoordinates := by
    simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, pairLightCachedCoordinates]
  rw [hmap, pairLightCoordinates_list_eq_iff]

theorem pairLightCachedCoordinates_signatures_eq {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) :
    ((cached.map pairLightCachedCoordinates).all fun x =>
      decide (x.2 = pairLightCoordinateSignature sieve x.1)) =
      (cached.all fun x => decide (x.signature = pairCoordinateSignature sieve x.vertex)) := by
  induction cached with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.all_cons, pairLightCachedCoordinates,
        pairLightCoordinateSignature_eq, ih]

/-- The complete arithmetic-only certificate is exactly the accepted raw
certificate for all parameters and all supplied lists. Ordered vertex coverage
and every canonical signature are preserved, including malformed data. -/
theorem pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_eq_raw {tau nu : ℤ}
    (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu))
    (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu)) (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ)) :
    pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool tau nu sieve
      (vertices.map pairLightCoordinates) (cached.map pairLightCachedCoordinates) rows =
      pairRawSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool sieve vertices cached rows := by
  simp only [pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool,
    pairRawSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool, pairLightCachedCoordinates_coverage_iff,
    pairLightCachedCoordinates_signatures_eq, pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentBool_eq_raw]

/-- Mathematical soundness is reused from the accepted checker only after
the unconditional Boolean identity. Positive discriminant is exactly the
original soundness premise and is not needed for the computation equality. -/
theorem pairIndependentBool_of_light_selected_floor_certificate {tau nu : ℤ}
    (hd : 0 < QuadInt.discriminant tau nu) (sieve : List (ℕ × ℕ))
    (vertices : List (QuadInt tau nu)) (cached : List (PairResidueVertex tau nu))
    (rows : List (ℕ × List ℕ))
    (hcheck : pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool tau nu sieve
      (vertices.map pairLightCoordinates) (cached.map pairLightCachedCoordinates) rows = true) :
    pairIndependentBool sieve vertices = true :=
  pairIndependentBool_of_raw_selected_floor_certificate hd sieve vertices cached rows
    ((pairLightSelectedFloorIndependentCertificateBool_eq_raw sieve vertices cached rows).symm.trans hcheck)

end D1Bound5
